curation.notes: ATCC 19115 type strain - serotype 4b reference strain. ST2 confirmed in literature for this strain. This is a well-characterized reference isolate used for serotype 4b validation. Assembly not available in NCBI - generate locally from reads.

reads.download_cmd: fasterq-dump --gzip --outdir data/ SRR10078142 && mv data/SRR10078142_1.fastq.gz data/reads_1.fq.gz && mv data/SRR10078142_2.fastq.gz data/reads_2.fq.gz

assembly.notes: Assembly not available in NCBI. Generate locally: spades.py -1 data/reads_1.fq.gz -2 data/reads_2.fq.gz -o assembly/ --careful && cp assembly/contigs.fasta data/contigs.fa

validation_instructions.serological: Expected serotype 4b (Lineage I). This is ATCC 19115, a reference strain for serotype 4b. Accept exact match '4b', 'serotype 4b', or '4b/4d/4e' (tools may group these). Do not accept 1/2b as PASS (different serotype, though both are Lineage I). Tool should confidently call 4b for this reference strain.
validation_instructions.mlst: Expected ST2 (lmonocytogenes scheme), serotype 4b, Lineage I. ATCC 19115 is documented as ST2 in literature. All 7 loci must be typed successfully: abcZ(1), bglA(1), cat(1), dapE(1), dat(1), ldh(1), lhkA(1). Accept exact ST2 match. Do not accept ST6 as PASS (also serotype 4b but distinct clone). This is a reference strain - exact match expected.

notes: ATCC 19115 is a well-characterized serotype 4b reference strain. ST2 is the major epidemic clone but this specific strain is used as a serotyping reference. Assembly must be generated locally from reads. High confidence in ground truth based on reference strain status.
